known_facts_book1: An old and ugly Wicked Witch who has lost one eye and wears a black patch over it, which is how the people of Jinxland came to name her.
Is the leader of all the other witches of Jinxland and therefore the most hated and feared, living in an eight-sided house with a door and a window in each side.
Demands large sums of money or heaps of jewels before she will work any enchantment, which is why King Krewl hates her.
Transforms the sleeping Cap'n Bill into a gray grasshopper with a wooden leg, using three packets of powder from a black bag.
Says love is a stubborn thing to conquer — that love and cats have nine lives — and proposes freezing Gloria's heart instead of killing her love.
Summons three other witches by tossing compounds into her kettle; each flash produces one, and they disguise themselves as beautiful maidens whose only undisguisable feature is their eyes.
Dashes a ladle of the incantation full on Gloria's breast with the words 'Love no more! Magic art now will freeze your mortal heart!'
Chases Trot and Pon across Jinxland on foot after they are caught spying, and passes them by because they hide on the side of her blind eye.
Tears the straw out of the Scarecrow's body, but misses his head, which rolls into a hollow.
Is found under a bush by the Orks and dragged before the Scarecrow's throne.
Is shrunk by a white dust from a box Glinda gave the Scarecrow, and forced to restore Cap'n Bill and thaw Gloria before she is given the antidote.

Stops shrinking at knee height but can never regain her size, and the second powder has secretly destroyed all her magic power — she tries a charm that would have destroyed half of Jinxland and nothing happens.

known_relations_book1.King Krewl: The King who pays her and threatens to burn her at the stake.
known_relations_book1.Googly-Goo: The courtier whose money buys her services.
known_relations_book1.Cap'n Bill: The sailor she turns into a grasshopper and is forced to restore.
known_relations_book1.Gloria: The Princess whose heart she freezes and is forced to thaw.
known_relations_book1.Scarecrow: Who shrinks her and strips her of magic with Glinda's two boxes.

not_in_this_book: Blinkie refuses to undo her spells
relationships: Blinkie is a friend of Gloria
Blinkie is an ally of the Scarecrow

known_facts_book1: Three ugly hags summoned by Blinkie, appearing one at a time as her kettle flashes three times.
Are transformed by their own castings into the kettle into maidens of exquisite beauty in the daintiest costumes, with only their eyes betraying the evil behind the illusion.
Dance around Gloria and take turns stirring the kettle and muttering the magic charm that freezes her heart.
Turn back into ugly crooked hags leaning on broomsticks and canes as soon as the charm succeeds.
Chase Trot and Pon out of the window, then fly away on their broomsticks and canes against the blue sky, and are never seen again.
Are never individually named in the book.

known_relations_book1.Blinkie: The one-eyed leader who summons and instructs them.
known_relations_book1.Gloria: The Princess whose heart they help freeze.

not_in_this_book: the three witches lose their powers
the three witches are beautiful without magic
